content.text: Summary: Checked the monitoring namespace and prometheus-k8s-0 logs, which showed "no space left on device" errors on /prometheus/wal starting at 03:02 and a failed compaction at 05:00 — the TSDB PVC is full, so scrapes have been failing. The PVC's StorageClass (gp3-resizable) has allowVolumeExpansion: true with a CSI provisioner and ext4, so I resolved the ticket advising the owner to grow the PVC in place; expansion is online and no pod restart is needed.
